text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Diagnosed as never being able to run 
seriously again, K.S.Miracle smiles 
gallantly, but has lost her positive 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to the aftermath of her accident, a 
heavy atmosphere hangs over the entire 
racing world. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daitaku Helios's vibes are totally peak. 
Times like this call for a real party 
animal. Crank the volume to max, go wild, 
and let nobody kill the vibe!
